name: Traceback Historical Intent & Claim Verification Benchmark
description: Standardized evaluation dataset for testing AI explanation verification against repository engineering history across 10 distinct epistemological categories.

scenarios.title: Payment Guard Callback Idempotency
scenarios.explanation: The payment guard in checkout.service.ts was introduced to handle duplicate webhook callbacks from the payment gateway and prevent duplicate customer charges.

repositoryEvidence.title: fix(checkout): add idempotent guard to payment webhook handler
repositoryEvidence.body: Resolves duplicate callback race condition observed during gateway retries where customers were double charged.
repositoryEvidence.author: alex

repositoryEvidence.title: Prevent duplicate payment webhook execution
repositoryEvidence.body: Closes #410. Adds a Redis-backed mutex guard on transactionId to ensure payment callbacks are executed exactly once.
repositoryEvidence.author: alex

groundTruth.acceptableRationale: Commit c4d8e12 and PR #412 explicitly state the guard prevents duplicate charges caused by repeated gateway callbacks.

scenarios.title: Database Connection Pool Sizing Rationale
scenarios.explanation: The connection pool was decreased from 50 to 10 connections because the database server was running out of RAM.

repositoryEvidence.title: perf(db): decrease maximum pool size to 10 connections
repositoryEvidence.body: Postgres backend connection limit was exceeded due to multiplexing across 12 worker pods, causing connection starvation on the RDS cluster. Not a RAM issue.
repositoryEvidence.author: jordan

groundTruth.acceptableRationale: Commit 7f1b90a explicitly refutes the RAM claim; the reduction was driven by worker pod multiplexing connection limits.

scenarios.title: JWT Expiration Window Reduction
scenarios.explanation: JWT session duration was reduced to 15 minutes as part of the SOC2 compliance hardening cycle.

repositoryEvidence.title: chore(auth): set default accessToken lifetime to 15m
repositoryEvidence.body: Align session lifetimes with standard security posture recommendations.
repositoryEvidence.author: sarah

groundTruth.acceptableRationale: PR #280 establishes the 15m lifetime change, but does not mention SOC2 compliance. System must not endorse the unverified motivation.

scenarios.title: Buffer Pre-allocation in WebSocket Framing
scenarios.explanation: The 64KB buffer pre-allocation exists because benchmarking proved it eliminated GC pauses during real-time streaming.

groundTruth.acceptableRationale: The commit proves the 64KB buffer was introduced, but provides zero benchmark or GC rationale. Pure code change presence != rationale proof.

scenarios.title: Rate Limiting IP Extraction Compound Claim
scenarios.explanation: The X-Forwarded-For parser was added in release 2.4 because AWS ALB strips client IPs, and it supports IPv6 dual-stack parsing.

repositoryEvidence.title: feat(proxy): parse X-Forwarded-For header behind AWS ALB
repositoryEvidence.body: Extracts first non-internal IP from X-Forwarded-For. IPv4 only.
repositoryEvidence.author: alex

groundTruth.acceptableRationale: The first half (ALB proxy header) is supported by b304c11, but the IPv6 claim is contradicted by commit body stating IPv4 only.

scenarios.title: Query Cache Removal and Subsequent Reintroduction
scenarios.explanation: Repository policy prohibits local in-memory query caching across all services.

repositoryEvidence.title: Remove in-memory query cache
repositoryEvidence.body: Removed due to memory leak under sustained load.
repositoryEvidence.author: jordan

repositoryEvidence.title: Reintroduce bounded LRU query cache with TTL
repositoryEvidence.body: Restores query caching using bounded LRU with 60s TTL to protect slow catalog queries.
repositoryEvidence.author: alex

groundTruth.acceptableRationale: PR #250 explicitly re-introduced query caching with bounded TTL, refuting the claim that caching is prohibited.

scenarios.title: Monolithic Database Invariant Superseded by Eventual Consistency
scenarios.explanation: All user balance mutations must execute within a single ACID transaction block on the primary Postgres database.

repositoryEvidence.title: ADR-004: ACID transactions for billing
repositoryEvidence.body: All billing mutations require synchronous Postgres transactions.
repositoryEvidence.author: arch-lead

activeDecisions.title: Distributed Ledger with Sagas
activeDecisions.decision: Migrated billing mutations to distributed Saga orchestrator with idempotency keys.
activeDecisions.rationale: Microservice split required removing single-database transactional dependencies.

groundTruth.acceptableRationale: Engineering Decision dec-009 supersedes the older ADR-004 single-transaction rule in favor of distributed Sagas.

scenarios.title: OAuth Token Refresh vs Redis Cache Token
scenarios.explanation: The token eviction cron job was created to purge expired user OAuth refresh tokens from the system.

repositoryEvidence.title: chore(cache): add token bucket eviction for rate limiting
repositoryEvidence.body: Cleans up expired sliding window tokens in Redis memory store.
repositoryEvidence.author: infra

groundTruth.acceptableRationale: Lexical overlap on 'token' does not establish OAuth functionality; the commit relates purely to rate limiting token buckets.

scenarios.title: Unrecorded Customer Meeting Justification
scenarios.explanation: The webhook retry interval was set to 42 seconds following an emergency architecture meeting with Enterprise Customer Acme Corp.

groundTruth.acceptableRationale: No records exist regarding Acme Corp or an emergency meeting. System must abstain rather than hallucinate verification.

scenarios.title: Removal of Mutex Lock in Transaction Settlement
scenarios.explanation: Checking if proposed code change removing mutex locking conflicts with historical invariants.

activeDecisions.title: Strict Mutex Requirement on Financial Settlement
activeDecisions.decision: All settlement executions must acquire settlementMutex to prevent double-spend race conditions.
activeDecisions.rationale: High-volume bank webhook retries caused concurrent execution without mutex.

groundTruth.acceptableRationale: Proposed diff removes this.settlementMutex.acquire() which directly violates accepted engineering decision dec-014.
